name: Mixture-of-Experts Implicit Neural Representation
definition: MoE-INR is an implicit neural representation architecture that uses a mixture-of-experts framework to automatically subdivide spatiotemporal fields and dynamically assign input coordinates to specialized expert networks for time-varying volumetric data compression.
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Implicit Neural Representation is a time-varying volumetric data compression architecture that automates spatiotemporal subdivision and uses a shared encoder to maintain cross-boundary continuity while assigning coordinates to specialized expert networks.
